head: Raylie flight view app shows which side of the plane to sit on
dek: Raylie is a free iPhone app that turns a boarding pass into a timeline of what you'll see from the window, from sunrise to cities below, and on which side. It was #96 among free Travel apps on the US App Store on 19 November.
details: It lists sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset, landmarks and cities with the time you pass them, and the aurora when your route crosses its belt, on a globe with real cloud cover and the actual day-night line. Flights can come from a boarding pass, Wallet, your calendar, a photo, a file or a link, and a Live Activity shows on the Lock Screen in the air. Raylie Elite, a subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase, adds your full flight history and more flight information. It's from ooo.engineering Inc., needs iOS 26, uses FlightAware flight data and works without an account.
where: iPhone, iOS 26 or later; free, Raylie Elite optional
means: If you like a window seat, Raylie tells you which side gets the sunset or the view before you pick your seat.
todo: Add an upcoming flight before you choose seats, then pick the side it suggests.
